newFamilies.rationale: 'search-match' names the two-sided discover-then-match pattern (query, filter, compare, inspect, transact). SM.01 Marketplace (freelancer/rental/provider/resale matching) captures that better than the narrower SM.02 Directory, SM.03 Real estate, SM.04 Jobs, or SM.05 Comparison archetypes, all of which are marketplace sub-cases.

'content-sub' = content subscription. CS.01 Publication or media (magazine/news/editorial, discover-consume-subscribe-return) is a direct, unambiguous match; CS.02/CS.03 are documentation/research-library variants, a narrower fit for the family name.

MI.01 Nonprofit or charity is the broader, more general MI archetype ('turn concern into contribution') matching a family named simply 'mission'; MI.02 Advocacy or campaign is the narrower political/petition sub-case.
